channel.title: Sabbath School Panel
channel.desc: This study confronts the great enemy-death-and celebrates Christ's victory over it. Death was never meant to be part of life; it entered through sin. But Paul boldly declares that Jesus died to destroy him who had the power of death. Though ready to die for Christ, Paul's true passion was to live for Him-to honor His name and share His gospel with all. Through his letters, Paul's voice still unites believers today.
